classification.difficultyReason: Identify and name the unmarked interior angle pair on the same side of a transversal.

content.prompt:
The two marked angles are co-interior angles: they are between the two lines and on the same side of the transversal $PQ$.

There is a second pair of co-interior angles in the diagram. Name the angles of this pair.

spec.sourceRegion: Bottom-right diagram under Co-interior angles, printed page 107
spec.description: Two unmarked lines AB and CD crossed by PQ at E and F respectively. Double arcs mark BEF and a single arc marks EFD. Ordinary source blue strokes are reconstructed in house black.
spec.mathematics: A,E,B and C,F,D are collinear; P,F,E,Q are collinear. The other co-interior pair is AEF and EFC. No parallel marks are supplied.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the source labels and marked pair are visible; the requested second pair is not highlighted.

answer.worked: $\angle AEF$ and $\angle EFC$ lie between $AB$ and $CD$, on the same side of the transversal $PQ$. They form the other pair of co-interior angles.
